scenarios.title: A permanent spell cast for its warp cost is exiled at the beginning of the next end step
decisions: A casts Memorial Team Leader for its warp cost {1}{R}, tapping two Mountains.
Both players pass; Memorial Team Leader resolves.
Both players pass through combat and the second main phase to the beginning of the end step; the delayed trigger goes on the stack and both players pass.

variants.label: warp_cast
variants.expected: Memorial Team Leader (4/3) is on the battlefield until the end step. At the beginning of the end step it is exiled (not put into the graveyard) and stays in exile.

variants.label: cast_for_mana_cost
variants.delta: A casts Memorial Team Leader for its mana cost {3}{R}, tapping four Mountains, instead of for its warp cost.
variants.expected: Memorial Team Leader (4/3) stays on the battlefield through the end step. No delayed trigger exiles it.

scenarios.forge_notes: Warp is implemented by registering a delayed trigger when the spell's permanent enters.

scenarios.title: A warped card in exile can be cast on a later turn, but not for its warp cost

setup.notes: It is a later turn of A than the one in which A cast Memorial Team Leader for its warp cost. The delayed trigger from that cast exiled Memorial Team Leader at the beginning of that turn's end step.

decisions: A checks whether Memorial Team Leader can be cast from exile for its mana cost {3}{R}, with four Mountains.

variants.label: warped_card_in_exile
variants.expected: Casting Memorial Team Leader from exile is legal for {3}{R}, payable with the four Mountains.

variants.label: exiled_by_other_effect
variants.delta: Memorial Team Leader is in exile because another effect exiled it, not because its warp delayed trigger did.
variants.expected: Casting Memorial Team Leader from exile is not legal.

variants.label: two_mountains
variants.expected: Casting Memorial Team Leader from exile is not legal: the warp cost {1}{R} can be used only when casting from hand, so only the mana cost {3}{R} applies from exile.

scenarios.title: A condition asking whether a spell was warped this turn is true after a spell was cast for its warp cost
decisions: A casts Memorial Team Leader for its warp cost {1}{R}, tapping two Mountains.
Both players pass; Memorial Team Leader resolves.
A casts Decode Transmissions, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Decode Transmissions resolves.

variants.label: spell_was_warped
variants.expected: Decode Transmissions resolves with its void condition true: A draws two cards (hand 2, library 1) and B loses 2 life (18). A's life stays 20. Memorial Team Leader is still on the battlefield.

variants.label: spell_not_warped
variants.delta: A casts Memorial Team Leader for its mana cost {3}{R}, tapping four Mountains, instead of for its warp cost.
variants.expected: Decode Transmissions resolves with its void condition false (no spell was warped and no nonland permanent left the battlefield): A draws two cards and A loses 2 life (18). B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Both spells are cast in the first main phase, so Memorial Team Leader has not yet been exiled; this keeps 'a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn' false and isolates 'a spell was warped this turn'.
